title: SixthView: A Benchmark for Hidden-View Reconstruction and 3D Assembly Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23891v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inferring the unseen side of a 3D assembly requires reasoning about part placement and occlusion. Different assemblies can match the observed views while producing different hidden views, leaving the target ambiguous. We introduce SixthView, a benchmark in which models predict a sixth orthographic view from five observed views and information about the component shapes. The benchmark contains 602 synthetic polycube assemblies with 2--10 parts and requires a dense grid of part labels for the missing view, allowing both exact-view and cell-level evaluation. For each item, we exhaustively verify that all legal assemblies consistent with the exact component geometry and observed label grids yield the same target view. With these inputs, the task tests symbolic assembly and coordinate reasoning. translated_title: SixthView：隐藏视图重建与3D组装推理基准
translated_abstract: 推断3D组装体不可见的侧面需要对零件的放置位置和遮挡关系进行推理。不同的组装体可能在匹配观测视图的同时产生不同的隐藏视图，从而使目标存在歧义。我们提出了SixthView，这是一个基准测试，要求模型根据五个观测视图和组件形状信息来预测第六个正交视图。该基准包含602个由2至10个零件组成的合成多立方体组装体，并要求对缺失视图输出密集的零件标签网格，从而支持精确视图和单元级别两种评估方式。对于每个条目，我们进行了穷举验证，确保所有与精确组件几何形状和观测标签网格一致的合法组装体都产生相同的目标视图。在这些输入条件下，该任务测试符号化组装和坐标推理能力。仅图像的变体还额外要求从渲染视图中恢复形状，在这种情况下，遮挡可能使不同的3D形状看起来完全相同。我们ev...
tldr: 提出SixthView基准，要求模型根据五个观测视图和组件形状信息推断第六个隐藏正交视图，以测试3D组装与坐标推理能力，并通过穷举验证确保每个条目的目标视图唯一。
en_tdlr: SixthView is a benchmark where models must infer a sixth hidden orthographic view from five observed views and component shape information, testing 3D assembly and coordinate reasoning with exhaustively verified unique target views.
